coreSecurity_urlReviewConfusableCharacte.en: The domain has characters that look like Latin letters
coreSecurity_urlReviewConfusableCharacte.zh: 域名里含有与拉丁字母同形的字符

coreSecurity_urlReviewCredentialsInUrl.en: The address contains a username or password, a common disguise
coreSecurity_urlReviewCredentialsInUrl.zh: 地址里带有用户名或密码，这是常见的伪装手法

coreSecurity_urlReviewIpLiteralHost.en: The address is an IP, not a domain; ownership can't be checked
coreSecurity_urlReviewIpLiteralHost.zh: 地址是 IP，不是域名，无法核对归属

coreSecurity_urlReviewMixedScriptLabel.en: One part of the domain mixes Latin letters with other scripts
coreSecurity_urlReviewMixedScriptLabel.zh: 域名的同一段里混用了拉丁字母与其他文字

coreSecurity_urlReviewNonAsciiHost.en: The domain has non-ASCII characters; its ASCII form can't be computed locally
coreSecurity_urlReviewNonAsciiHost.zh: 域名含有非 ASCII 字符，本地无法计算它的 ASCII 形式

coreSecurity_urlReviewNotHttps.en: Only HTTPS is allowed; plain-text or custom schemes are blocked
coreSecurity_urlReviewNotHttps.zh: 只允许 HTTPS，明文或自定义协议一律阻止

coreSecurity_urlReviewPunycodeLabel.en: The domain has an IDN-encoded (xn--) label that can't be turned back into readable form locally
coreSecurity_urlReviewPunycodeLabel.zh: 域名含有 IDN 编码（xn--）标签，无法在本地还原成可读形式

coreSecurity_urlReviewSchemeAssumed.en: No scheme given; read as HTTPS
coreSecurity_urlReviewSchemeAssumed.zh: 没有写协议，已按 HTTPS 解析

coreSecurity_urlReviewUnsafeCharacters.en: The input has control or invisible characters
coreSecurity_urlReviewUnsafeCharacters.zh: 输入里含有控制字符或不可见字符
